items.title: Air Products (APD) Stock May Be 13% Undervalued Despite Raised 2027 Outlook
items.summary: Air Products and Chemicals has climbed to around US$316 per share after a solid multi year run and upbeat earnings news, which naturally puts the spotlight on one issue for investors. Is the current share price properly backed by the cash flows that the business is expected to generate over time, or has sentiment moved ahead of what the numbers support? The stock has returned about 26.7% over the past 3 years, so a lot of shareholder value now rests on whether those gains are underpinned by...

items.title: Profit Return Might Change The Case For Investing In Air Products And Chemicals Stock (APD)
